fields.hero_prompt: Build a landscaping landing page that saves every estimate request to a database I own.

faq_plan.q: What is a landscaping landing page?
How do I create a landscaping landing page?

plan.angle: The SERP for landscaping landing page is thin (MSV 20, no Semrush variants) and its AlsoAsked set is all consumer pricing and design-trend questions: nothing shows a landscaping company what happens to an estimate request after the visitor sends it. This page shows four landscaping landing pages built around the request itself: a design-build form that sends $10,000-plus projects to the designer, a mowing page that turns a side of town into a route day, a spring cleanup page that sends long-neglected yards to a walkthrough, and a commercial page that splits year-round contracts from one-time jobs. Each tab shows the form, the routing and the numbers behind it, then the steps build the same thing. No pesticide, plant-care, licensing or pricing-benchmark claims, nothing state-specific, and no third-party facts, so the page needs no domain sources. HVAC, roofing, plumber, contractor, pest control, cleaning service, electrician and solar are siblings and stay out of the headings.
tab_stories: Fernhollow Landscape Design opens its project form on the project type and a budget range; a request at $10,000 or more emails designer Imara Castellanos to set a site visit, and this month 17 of 26 project requests reached her while 9 took the phone estimate.

Mossbank Lawn Care asks which side of town the yard is on and shows the mowing day right away, Tuesday for the north side and Friday for the south side; this week 38 mowing requests split 23 to Tuesday's route and 15 to Friday's.

Birchlaw Yard Services books spring cleanups on one question, when the yard was last cleaned up: Last fall gets the standard price and Over a year ago sends crew lead Soren Abellard out for a walkthrough; Monday morning's 12 cleanup requests split 7 standard and 5 walkthroughs.

Stonewick Property Grounds asks whether a commercial property wants year-round care or a one-time job; year-round requests go to estimator Halina Grosz and one-time jobs go to the office queue, and this quarter 11 grounds requests split 4 to Halina and 7 to the office.
